relations.text: セルフレジやPOSのハードウェアの設計・製造を委託する商業契約を2024年8月に結んだ
relations.text_en: Entered a commercial agreement in August 2024 for Ennoconn to design and manufacture its self-checkout and point-of-sale hardware

source.label: NCRボイックス 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: On August 6, 2024, we announced our entry into a commercial agreement with Ennoconn Corporation (“Ennoconn”) to transition our self-checkout and point-of-sale hardware businesses to an outsourced design and manufacturing model (“ODM”), including the sale of certain assets relating to these businesses (the “Hardware Business Transition”).
